items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I remember that, with Leon Herriford--and I can't think of the lady's name now. Lionel wouldn't, or couldn't, pay salaries that would enable us to take care of our families... so by July most of us quit.

ctx.x: There was Paul Howard; was he a bandleader at one time?
That's right, he was very famous with the Quality Serenaders way back in the early twenties. I remember that, with Leon Herriford--and I can't think of the lady's name now.
